name: 动作加速（DTMAPI）
author: Yuuka
description:
依赖 DTMAPI。
加速工具、装水、吃喝、交互和采集等动作，可在标题页 DTMAPI 设置里配置。

localized_description.schinese:

localized_description.tchinese:
依賴 DTMAPI。

localized_description.english:
Requires DTMAPI.
Speeds up tool use, watering fill, eating/drinking, interactions, and gathering.
Configure it from the DTMAPI Settings button on the title screen.
